entities.name: Leonid Kanter
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Leonid Kanter was a Ukrainian documentary filmmaker, writer, and cultural activist. He was best known for his films chronicling the Russo-Ukrainian War and for co-founding the Obyrok art village in northern Ukraine.
